verdict.rationale: The first-party docs back both halves of the story. For maintainability, React offers encapsulated, composable components, TypeScript support and the eslint-plugin-react-hooks rules. For performance, it offers React Compiler's automatic build-time optimization (adoptable incrementally), DevTools for finding performance problems, and streaming server rendering via frameworks. Missing for 10: explicit evidence on scaling to large teams and codebases, and independent or hands-on corroboration that large React apps stay fast (community items only comment on React's scheduling design).
